name: Sharkdropship & affiliate for Amazon
author: Marc dooder

sections.description:
🌐 🚀🚀 Links:
* Website: SharkDropship.com
* Go Pro: Upgrade to Premium
* Chrome Extension: Download

🚀🚀 Sharkdropship for Amazon is a comprehensive dropshipping solution that allows you to import products directly from Amazon to your WooCommerce store. With our Chrome extension, you can import products with just one click and automatically extract all product data including images, prices, and descriptions.

🚀 Watch the full video tutorial

🚀 How to use the chrome extension

Key Features

  • One-click Product Import: Import products directly from Amazon using our Chrome extension
  • Automatic Data Extraction: Automatically extract product images, prices, and descriptions
  • Bulk Import: Import multiple variations as separate products at once
  • Product Analytics: Track views, sales, and revenue for your Amazon products
  • WooCommerce Integration: Seamlessly integrates with your existing WooCommerce store
  • Responsive Dashboard: Beautiful, modern admin interface

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/amazon-sharkdropship-plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Install the Chrome extension for product import functionality
  4. Start importing products from Amazon!

Chrome Extension

The Chrome extension is required for product import functionality. It allows you to:

  • Import products with one click
  • Extract product data automatically
  • Bulk import multiple products
  • Manage your product catalog
